name: github-follow-manager
description: Tools for checking who follows you on GitHub, unfollowing users, and analyzing follow relationships.

tools.name: initialize
tools.description: Initialize the GitHub API service with a personal access token

token.description: GitHub personal access token with appropriate scopes

tools.name: get-current-user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated GitHub user

tools.name: get-not-following-back
tools.description: Get the list of GitHub users who don't follow you back

usernames.description: List of GitHub usernames to unfollow

tools.name: get-follow-relationships
tools.description: Get detailed follow relationships for all users you follow
